product_metadata.title: Gardman 8400 Spanish Arch Wall Art, Antique Rust, 30.23" Long x 19.11" Wide
features: Elegant scroll detail with Spanish architectural influence
Antique rust finish features brown, orange and verdigris
Durable steel construction will provide years of use
May be hung indoors or out
description: Gardman 8400 Spanish Wall Art. Add sculpture to your home or garden wall with this decorative Spanish arch wall art. This beautiful design evokes the classic architecture of Spain with elegant curved scroll work, and small leaf shapes throughout. The attractive antique rust finish contains brown, orange, and verdigris colors. Durable steel construction makes this perfect for use indoors or out. Easily mounts to any flat surface with small built-in loop. Dimensions: 30.23" Long x 19.11" Wide x .78” High. Gardman "Bring your garden to life"
